'''Wraiths''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Preeminent Parasites|Preeminent]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawns in groups of 2 in the [[Parasite Biome]], with a spawnweight of 5.
*Can spawn naturally, once a [[Colony]] with at least 15 points exists in the dimension, individually with a spawnweight of 1.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Wraiths are Flying, Stealth Ranged units with additional melee capabilities.

* Wraiths can rapidly shoot Nades in bursts of 3.
** Wraiths will not do this if their target is in midair.
* Wraiths have a damaging, immunity frame ignoring, melee aura.
* Wraiths can spawn [[Succor|Succors]].
*Wraiths can go completely invisible. This invisibility is disrupted when it shoots, takes damage, or if its health goes below 40% of its max health. Succors spawned during this invisibility will spawn with the invisibility effect for 3 seconds.
*Wraiths can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 15, with a 20 ticks cooldown and 5 Blocks range.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
*Wraiths, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.

== ''Trivia'' ==
*Wraiths are also known as '''Elvia''' in the Mod Files.
*A "wraith", in common usage, is another term for a ghost or other apparition, having a similar meaning to "haunter" or "bogle".
